name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength
summary: A transferable writ requests an Elixir of Ogre's Strength and gives a delivery place and payment terms. Sos'mol receives the elixir and remembers your help.

sections.title: A Customer's Writ
sections.body: The faded note asks you to bring one Elixir of Ogre's Strength. It is transferable, and it gives a delivery location and payment information. Keep the writ with you for the exchange.

sections.title: Sos'mol's Thanks
sections.body: Sos'mol thanks you for bringing the elixir and says no ogre has helped him this way before. He promises to remember your kindness and repay you someday.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one Elixir of Ogre's Strength.
Sos'mol is the customer who receives the elixir.

faq.q: Can someone else carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: What do I need for the exchange?
faq.answer: Bring the requested elixir and keep the writ in your possession for the transaction.

faq.q: What does Sos'mol say after receiving it?
faq.answer: Sos'mol says he will remember your help and promises to repay you someday.
